descriptionChirho: A cultivated plot or enclosed garden, used of orchards, pleasure gardens, and the primordial Garden of Eden; uniformly rendered across all six witness languages as garden/huerto/jardín (spa), बाग/बाग़ (hin), جنّة/حديقة (arb), 동산/정원 (kor), bustani (swa), with variation only in grammatical inflection (prepositions, articles, construct chains, possessive suffixes, and number).

Proper-noun usage of gan as a place name (ha-Gannah), evidenced by Hindi rendering the word as a transliteration הג्गान rather than translating it as बाग, distinguishing it from the common noun; tagged N-proper-fs in the morphological data.
